# These variables can be copied to .env for local development
# Copy this file to .env and adjust values for your local setup: cp .env.defaults .env

# Core application environment
NODE_ENV=production # We want to simulate production as close as possible
APP_ENV=production # Application environment (development/production)
LOG_LEVEL=info # Logging level (debug/info/warn/error)
COOKIE_NAME=app-cookie # Name of the session cookie
BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 # Base URL for local development
WEBAPP_APP_TITLE=buildplace.io # Application title

# Database configuration - REQUIRED for local development
DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Main database connection
MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Database URL for migrations
TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test # Test database connection
BYPASS_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_dev # Database URL for bypassing RLS
SHADOW_DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_shadow # Shadow database for migrations
TEST_DIRECT_URL=postgres://postgres:postgrespw@localhost:5432/ffy_test # Direct test database URL
RATE_LIMIT_MAX=10000000000 # Maximum rate limit for API requests

# Redis configuration - REQUIRED
VALKEY_SERVER=localhost # Redis server hostname
VALKEY_PORT=6379 # Redis server port
BULL_PREFIX=local # Prefix for Bull queue jobs

# Web application configuration
WEBAPP_DOMAIN=http://localhost:3000 # Domain for the web application
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_TILESERVER=https://example.com # URL for tile server
WEBAPP_OGRE_API=https://ogre.example.com # URL for OGRE API
WEBAPP_MAP_MAPTILER_KEY=your_maptiler_key_here # API key for MapTiler
WEBAPP_MAP_GEOAPIFY_KEY=your_geoapify_key_here # API key for Geoapify
WEBAPP_PUBLIC_URL="" # Public URL for the webapp
WEBAPP_SELFSERVING_DGM_TILES=https://example.com/tiles # URL for DGM tiles
WEBAPP_TILESERVER_KEY=your_tileserver_key_here # API key for tile server
WEBAPP_DEV_USER_PW=your_dev_password_here # Development user password

# Security keys - GENERATE RANDOM STRINGS FOR PRODUCTION
SESSION_KEY=your_session_key_here # Random string for session encryption (generate with crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))
STORAGE_KEY=your_storage_key_here # API key for storage service
STORAGE_SECRET=your_storage_secret_here # Secret for storage service
CRYPTO_SECRET=your_crypto_secret_here # Secret for symmetric encryption - REQUIRED for tests

# Storage configuration
STORAGE_BUCKET=dev # Storage bucket name
STORAGE_URL=storage.example.com # Storage service URL

# Mail configuration
MAIL_SMTP=mail.example.com # SMTP server for sending emails
MAIL_NOREPLY_USER=noreply@example.com # Email address for no-reply emails
MAIL_NOREPLY_PW=your_mail_password # Password for no-reply email account

# Self-serving API
SELFSERVING_API=https://selfservice.example.com # URL for self-serving API
SELFSERVING_KEY=your_selfserving_key_here # API key for self-serving service

# Monitoring and observability
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=buildplace # OpenTelemetry service name (used by NodeSDK)
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://localhost:4318 # OpenTelemetry collector OTLP HTTP endpoint

# XPlanBox configuration
XPLANBOX_URL=https://xplanbox.example.com # XPlanBox service URL
XPLANBOX_USER=your_xplanbox_user # XPlanBox username
XPLANBOX_PASSWORD=your_xplanbox_password # XPlanBox password

# Ladybug API URL
# TO-DO: Update this URL for production deployments
WEBAPP_COMFORT_ANALYSIS_SERVER=http://localhost:3100 # URL for Ladybug API
